S01.statement: A split function returning ErrFinalToken with non-nil empty token makes Scan return true once, then false with nil Err; with nil token the first Scan is false with nil Err.
S01.fragment: stops with no error. A non-nil token

S02.statement: Calling Scanner.Buffer or Scanner.Split after Scan was called panics even when the first Scan returned false for empty input.
S02.fragment: Buffer panics if it is called after scanning has started.
